scope: GRI1 read-only native raster discovery and AXI/control regressions; numeric policy is disclosed, not full GLES precision qualification

Simultaneous AR/AW ownership and held RDATA controls, unified register/reset/fill behavior and buffered/unbuffered VM ownership pass.
Both generated native headers and all four ABI checks pass. C11 combined-header/static-layout probes pass; all2374 prior definitions are preserved and46 discovery constants are added.
limitations: This qualifies discovery/control transport only. Word4/5 constants and floating policy1 disclose the candidate algorithm; the full raster minimum-resolvable-difference contract has a separately confirmed counterexample and remains open.
